sn36.31:1.1: atthi bhikkhave sāmisā pīti, atthi nirāmisā pīti, atthi nirāmisā nirāmisatarā pīti.
sn36.31:1.2: atthi sāmisaṃ sukhaṃ, atthi nirāmisaṃ sukhaṃ, atthi nirāmisā nirāmisataraṃ sukhaṃ.
sn36.31:1.3: atthi sāmisā upekhā, atthi nirāmisā upekhā, atthi nirāmisā nirāmisatarā upekhā.
sn36.31:1.4: atthi sāmiso vimokkho, atthi nirāmiso vimokkho, atthi nirāmisā nirāmisataro vimokkho.
sn36.31:1.8: cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā …pe…
sn36.31:1.9: kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
sn36.31:1.11: yā kho bhikkhave ime pañca kāmaguṇe paṭicca uppajjati pīti, ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave sāmisā pīti.
sn36.31:2.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
sn36.31:2.3: vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
sn36.31:3.1: katamā ca bhikkhave nirāmisā nirāmisatarā pīti:
sn36.31:3.2: yā kho bhikkhave khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno rāgā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ paccavekkhato dosā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ paccavekkhato mohā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ paccavekkhato uppajjati pīti. ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave nirāmisā nirāmisatarā pīti.
sn36.31:4.4: cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā …pe…
sn36.31:4.5: kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
sn36.31:4.7: yaṃ kho bhikkhave ime pañcakāmaguṇe paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ, idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave sāmisaṃ sukhaṃ.
sn36.31:5.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
sn36.31:5.3: vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
sn36.31:5.4: pītiyā ca virāgā upekhako ca viharati sato sampajāno sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti, yaṃ taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti upekhako satimā sukhavihārīti taṃ tatiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
sn36.31:6.2: yaṃ kho bhikkhave khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno rāgā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ paccavekkhato dosā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ paccavekkhato mohā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ paccavekkhato uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ, idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave nirāmisānirāmisataraṃ sukhaṃ.
sn36.31:7.4: cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā …pe…
sn36.31:7.5: kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
sn36.31:7.7: yā kho bhikkhave ime pañca kāmaguṇe paṭicca uppajjati upekhā, ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave sāmisā upekhā.
sn36.31:8.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
sn36.31:9.1: katamā ca bhikkhave nirāmisā nirāmisatarā upekhā:
sn36.31:9.2: yā kho bhikkhave khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno rāgā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ paccavekkhato dosā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ paccavekkhato mohā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ paccavekkhato uppajjati upekhā, ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave nirāmisā nirāmisatarā upekhā.
sn36.31:12.1: katamo ca bhikkhave nirāmisā nirāmisataro vimokkho:
sn36.31:12.2: yo kho bhikkhave khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno rāgā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ paccavekkhato dosā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ paccavekkhato mohā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ paccavekkhato uppajjati vimokkho, ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave nirāmisā nirāmisataro vimokkhoti.
